description:
Perform a monthly inventory audit for the 'Adacel' (Tdap) vaccine stock. A physical count revealed that Lot 'ADC-AUDIT-25' has only 12 doses remaining, but the system currently shows 25. 

1. Log in to Oscar EMR (Username: oscardoc, Password: oscar, PIN: 1117).
2. Navigate to the Prevention/Immunization administration section (Administration > Prevention/Screening > Search/Edit/Delete Vaccine Lot).
3. Find the lot 'ADC-AUDIT-25'.
4. Update the remaining quantity/units to exactly 12.
5. Save the record.
